parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.content_pipeline (topic, slides_data, linkedin_caption, status, channel) 
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.topic_sql }}', 
  '{{ $json.slides_sql }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.caption_sql }}',
  'rendering',
  'all'
) 
RETURNING id, slides_data, linkedin_caption;

UPDATE public.content_pipeline 
SET 
  media_paths = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.media_urls) }}'::jsonb, 
  instagram_media_paths = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.instagram_media_urls) }}'::jsonb,
  pdf_url = '{{ $json.pdf_url }}',
        status = 'draft', 
  scheduled_at = (
    CASE 
      WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') IN (1, 2, 3, 4) 
        AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') < 19 THEN
        ((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date + CASE 
          WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') < 8 THEN TIME '08:45'
          WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') < 12 THEN TIME '12:15'
          WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') < 17 THEN TIME '17:15'
          ELSE TIME '19:45'
        END) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'
      WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') = 5 THEN 
        ((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date + INTERVAL '3 days' + TIME '08:45') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'
      WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') = 6 THEN 
        ((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date + INTERVAL '2 days' + TIME '08:45') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'
      WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') = 0 THEN 
        ((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date + INTERVAL '1 day' + TIME '08:45') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'
      ELSE 
        ((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date + INTERVAL '1 day' + TIME '08:45') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'
    END
  ),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}';
